mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 1% indicates an accommodative monetary policy that supports equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 1% (based on historical data from 2000-2007).

mechanism_narrative: A CPI index above 275 indicates high inflation, which leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances when CPIAUCSL is above 275 (based on historical data from 2000-2007).

mechanism_narrative: When both housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) are above their 3-month moving averages, it signals strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both above their 3-month moving averages
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in more than 40% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS are above their 3-month moving averages (based on historical data from 2000-2007).

mechanism_narrative: A labor market unemployment rate below 4.5% indicates a tight labor market that supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances when UNRATE is below 4.5 (based on historical data from 2000-2007).

mechanism_narrative: An industrial production index above 101.5 indicates strong supply conditions that support corporate profitability, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances when INDPRO is above 101.5 (based on historical data from 2000-2007).

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary easing cycle (defined by FEDFUNDS < 1% and UNRATE < 4.5%), a federal funds rate below 1% supports equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 1% and UNRATE < 4.5% (based on historical data from 2000-2007).

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts level above 1500 (thousands) indicates strong housing demand, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in more than 40% of instances when HOUST is above 1500 (based on historical data from 2000-2007).

mechanism_narrative: An industrial production index above 100 indicates strong supply conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in more than 40% of instances when INDPRO is above 100 (based on historical data from 2000-2007).
